body.statement: If \(\Gamma_A=1\), then \(w_{0,x}=w_{1,x}=\pi_x\) for every \(x\), so \(L=R=\sum_x\lambda_x(r_{1,x}-r_{0,x})\).  If \(\Gamma_0=\Gamma_1=1\), then on the strictly positive chart the two joint-cell equalities force \(\mu_{a,0,x}=\mu_{a,1,x}=r_{a,x}\) for every \((a,x)\); continuity of the endpoint objectives gives the same point-identification formula on the closed class.
body.justification: These reductions are mandatory checks that either absent treatment-confounder association or absent outcome-confounder association removes bias.
body.gap: The reductions are implicit in fixed-parameter analyses but have not been stated as boundary faces of a sharp bounded envelope.
body.consumer: They provide unit tests for implementations and an interpretable origin for the tipping atlas.
